card: Backports eight pull requests to the 32.x maintenance branch for the 32.2 release. Key changes revert GUI-generated PSBTs from version 2 back to version 0 to resolve tool compatibility issues for users, make STL helper fields public to avoid Clang 24 build warnings, adjust Guix codesign archive ownership options, disable ARM32 tests in CI, and resolve test flakes and false-pass bugs in functional tests. All backported commits have already been merged into master.
changed_since_previous: Added backports of #36848 (dropping a flaky check in interface_http.py) and #36869 (making STL helper struct fields in memusage.h public to avoid Clang 24 warnings), along with an update to the v32.x release notes.
evidence: PR description lists eight backported PRs already merged into master: #36405, #36406, #36539, #36615, #36617, #36701, #36848, and #36869.
Commit dba6a52b6d notes that 'PSBTv2 is not very interesting for current GUI users, and defaulting to it causes issues for existing users.'
Commit 02881236d6 notes that 'Since llvm/llvm-project#237374, Clang 24 diagnoses these fields with -Wunused-private-field.'
problem: The 32.x maintenance branch lacks several bug fixes and test adjustments already merged into master. In particular, defaulting to PSBTv2 in the GUI broke compatibility for users with older external tools, Clang 24 flagged unused private fields in layout-mimicking STL helper structs, and multiple functional tests suffered from flakes or assertions that trivially passed due to type mismatches.

risk.why: Touches GUI PSBT serialization defaults and build/tooling files, but all commits are established backports from master.

scope_notes: Standard backport bundle PR combining cleanly cherry-picked commits from master for a point release.
summary: Backports eight pull requests to the 32.x maintenance branch and updates release notes for v32.x. Notable changes include reverting GUI-created PSBTs from version 2 back to version 0, adding `--no-same-owner` to Guix codesigning tar options, silencing Clang 24 unused-field warnings in memory usage helper structs, disabling ARM32 test runs in CI, and fixing multiple test flakes and silent false passes in functional tests.
